title: How Often Should You Service a Washing Machine?
html:
A front-load washing machine in an Indian home needs a professional service roughly once a year, and a descaling wash every two months in hard-water areas.

How often should a washing machine be serviced?

Once every twelve months for normal household use. Push it to eighteen months and you are usually paying for a drain pump instead of a service visit.

Why does regular servicing matter?

Detergent residue and hard-water scale build up on the drum, the heater and the drain filter. Scale on a heating element is the single most common cause of a machine that suddenly takes twice as long to finish a cycle.

Signs your machine is overdue

Longer cycle times, a smell that survives an empty hot wash, water still standing in the drum, or a drum that rocks visibly during the spin.

How much does servicing cost?

Between 500 and 900 rupees in most metros for a standard service, before parts. A drain pump replacement is closer to 2,500.

title: What AC Servicing Actually Costs in Indian Cities
html:
A split AC service runs between 450 and 800 rupees depending on the city and whether the technician does a jet wash or a dry clean.

What is included in a standard service?

Filter cleaning, coil cleaning, drain line clearing, gas pressure check and a general electrical inspection. A jet wash of the indoor unit costs more and is worth it once a year.

When are you being overcharged?

Any quote that bundles a gas top-up into a routine service is a flag. A correctly sealed system does not lose refrigerant annually.

title: Refrigerator Not Cooling: A Checklist Before You Call Anyone
html:
Four of the five most common causes of a warm refrigerator cost nothing to rule out.

Check the door seal first

Close the door on a sheet of paper. If it slides out without resistance, the gasket is the problem and it is a part swap, not a compressor job.

Then check airflow

A freezer packed to the roof blocks the vent that feeds cold air down to the fresh-food compartment. Clear a hand's width around the vent and wait six hours.

Then check the coils

Dust on the condenser coils at the back is the single most common cause of gradual cooling loss in Indian homes.

title: Choosing a Water Purifier for Indian Municipal Water
html:
The right purifier depends on one number you can get for free: your water's TDS.

Get your TDS reading first

Below 200 ppm, a UV purifier is enough and costs far less to run. Above 500 ppm you need RO. Between the two, an RO plus UV unit is the safe default.

Running costs matter more than the sticker price

Filter replacement over five years usually exceeds the purchase price. Ask for the annual consumable cost before you compare units.

title: A Realistic Smart Home Starting Point
html:
Start with the two devices that pay for themselves, not the ones that demo well.

Start with lighting and a plug

Smart bulbs in the rooms you actually use, and one smart plug on the geyser. That is the whole first phase.

Skip the hub until you need it

Under about eight devices, a hub adds a failure point and solves nothing.

title: Geyser Thermostat Quick Tip
html:
Set it to sixty

Sixty degrees is hot enough and halves scale buildup.
plaintext: Set it to sixty degrees. Sixty is hot enough and halves scale buildup.
excerpt: Sixty degrees is hot enough and halves scale buildup.
custom_excerpt: Sixty degrees is hot enough for any household task, and it roughly halves the rate at which scale forms on the heating element.
